name.description: Full name of the Bible version

version.description: Standard abbreviation of the Bible version (e.g. KJV)

edition_year.description: Year of publication or translation completion

publisher_source.description: Publisher or corpus provider of the text

source_url.description: Source URL or citation of the text

download_date.description: Date when the translation was downloaded/frozen (YYYY-MM-DD)

checksum_hash.description: SHA256 checksum of dataset relative paths and file contents

books_count.description: Number of books in this version

chapters_count.description: Number of chapters in this version

verses_count.description: Number of verses in this version

testaments.description: Testaments included in this version (ot, nt)

notes.description: Additional notes about the translation, source, or features
